## Publication Information

**Date:** 1875

**Imprint:** London: Longman

**Notes:** This originally appeared as 'Questions of the Day', an irregular series of articles on theology in the <i>Monthly Packet</i> (June 1871-May 1875).



See also [Elizabeth Sewell](../people/person_1301.qmd).
